Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Madras to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) for a temporary project position under an ICMR-sponsored project based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this IIT Madras notification?
faq.answer: The post announced in this official notification is Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) under advertisement number ICSR/PR/Advt.200/2026.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) position at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Madras Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) recruitment is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a first-class PG degree with 5 years of experience, a PhD, or a second-class PG degree with a PhD and 5 years of experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) position is set at 45 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 78,000/- plus 30% HRA, totaling Rs. 1,01,400/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for this role involves screening of applications, followed by a written test and an interview conducted by IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q9. How can eligible candidates apply for the job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official IIT Madras careers and current openings portal through the designated application link.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification link?
faq.answer: You can find the direct link to the official notification PDF and application portal in the Important Links section of this article.
